item.text: Shell inspection is blocked by the local sandbox launcher. I’m using the supplied evidence to redesign the opening around earlier western artillery damage and clearance of all four roadblocks; the prior eastern damage setup did not sustain either duty.

The revised structure assigns a separate attacker to each roadblock, aiming to get both civilians safely through before the artillery returns west. Two mutually covered medics support the central blockers and artillery attackers, while fresh defenders take over the outer lanes after device clearance.

The static DP check passes without refunds, provided both vanguards survive to generate their scheduled DP. The plan delays western device work until the artillery has moved east, clears the eastern devices with the outer interceptors, and keeps both medics supporting the artillery attack. These timings remain an untested tactical hypothesis.
